purpose: Desired-state registry of bounded privilege grants (sudoers) that agents may propose and only the human operator may install. An agent never applies a grant; it proposes exact file content, the operator reviews and installs, and this file records what SHOULD be present. Observed state comes from `sudo -l` read-back, never from this file.

proposal_convention.rule: Agent proposes the EXACT sudoers file content in a reviewable block plus a risk note (what breaks if abused, how to revoke). Operator installs by hand. Proposal and installation are two separate, individually explicit acts — never one gesture.
proposal_convention.binding: What the operator installs must equal what the agent proposed, verbatim. Any delta is a new proposal.
proposal_convention.revocation: Delete the grant file on the node, remove the entry here. A grant absent from the node but present here is drift (node behind); a grant present on the node but absent here is unauthorized (report, do not silently adopt).
proposal_convention.read_back: After install, `sudo -l -U <user>` on the node must show exactly the granted verbs. Record the check output reference (not the secret) in the entry.

grants.content: cynic ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/systemctl restart cynic-node.service, /bin/systemctl is-active cynic-node.service, /usr/bin/systemctl restart cynic-node.service, /usr/bin/systemctl is-active cynic-node.service
permits: restart + active-state read-back of cynic-node.service only
grants.purpose: Runtime-update activation (contracts/runtime-update.json step 5) for canary deploys without per-deploy operator gesture.
grants.read_back_ref: operator-pasted read-back 2026-10-07: visudo -c parsed OK on all sudoers sources; `sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl is-active cynic-node.service` returned active without password — amended grant (both systemctl paths) functional
grants.risk_note: Abuse ceiling: restart loop of one already-public service (DoS of node supervision, self-healing via rollback design). No data access, no lateral movement: verbs are unit-scoped, no wildcards, no shell.
